scope: Offline source fixes, saved-device evidence audit, official and first-person troubleshooting research. No new device connection or device PASS. Current decisions are in dev_출시전_핵심코어_체크리스트.txt.

A01.interpretation: Saved failures fit the OS minimum-futurity clamp after a near-target rearm. Pixel dump reports min_futurity=5s. No corresponding failure assigned to Motorola/realme.
A01.change: Move a periodic guard heartbeat that would land in the final 10 seconds before an alarm to target+1s. Preserve DB revalidation, failed scheduling retry, stale OS repair, restore gate and midnight/20-minute branches. Log GUARD_BOUNDARY_SHIFT and GUARD_REARM source/lead/target.
A01.before_tests: build/dev_offline_2026_10_07/guard_before_clock_fixed.log: two expected FAILs with instrumented virtual time. Earlier uninstrumented test-clock failure is not product evidence.
A01.after_tests: build/dev_offline_2026_10_07/guard_after.log: G1WakeSyncTest passed; includes stale PendingIntent repair and failed schedule retry.
A01.limit: Delayed delivery of a heartbeat or direct trigger/retry near the target still requires real-device observation. No claim of an OS-wide timing guarantee.

A02.model: Infinix NOTE50 Pro+ X6856 / Android 15 / XOS 15.1.2
A02.observed: hiber_app_root.txt: 17:48:33.473 freeze UID10294; .476 proxy same app alarm target1791366660000; saved delivery 213108ms late after wake. Awake control was 30ms. Standard DeviceIdle ACTIVE does not prove vendor Hiber inactive.
A02.evidence_limit: hiber_dump.txt is empty. recents_locked.png and recent_check_locked.png were visually reviewed; neither proves an active recent-app lock on ShiftBell. Existing battery settings must not be reported as a proven remedy.
A02.next: Confirm recent lock and all previously selected settings; cancel only test reservations, create a fresh foreground UI alarm, then lock without clock changes. If still held, use prepared dev-debug native receiver in separate alarm_clock/allow_idle rounds, record original epoch and Hiber evidence before waking.
A02.probe: android/app/src/debug/kotlin/com/hwani1103/shiftbell/DebugAlarmDeliveryProbe.kt; debug manifest only, dev package + debuggable gate, shell DUMP permission. Never writes app DB or controls real alarm audio.
A02.external_evidence: The Android 15/XOS developer report is unanswered; old XOS GitHub workarounds and Alarmy's general guidance are hypotheses, not proof for this ROM. No verified app-only fix found in reviewed sources.
